full_page.content:
1937, May
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 184 Cont.
May 3rd Rita Relesky - 9 - had double pneumonia seven yrs. ago, was "seven days like dead". Then she came too but ever since has been unable to talk. Was enrolled in the Ser. Masses and mother requested a Mass every day in May: Happy to say Child is already beginning to talk again.
Eunice Reid - 31 - Methodist minister's daughter - losing hearing ... Mary Nilan - a hospital in pittfield, Mass.
Mary Hammond - 83 - in Pittsfield, Mass"Christian Church" ... ! her daughter asks prayers ....
Page 185 May 5th
Mary Parks .- wants house ( 6 or 7 rooms)
Mary Manderano - 18 - invalid - going to Mrs. Willett ..... discourage
Ernest Sommerville - 45 - very nerveous-limbs very tardy ... like stroke Eddie Fitzpatrick
Herb Campion - 56 - Southern, very hard of hearing .....
Mrs. Tobin - see April 7th - no operation on cataracts is OK ... Thanks
Michael Halter - 69 - blind now a year. Had operation in September 1935 on one eye which since then has been totally lost. The fearful pain that the operations - went after enrolling in the Ser. Mass Ass'n Mrs. Rombalski - 47 - Spinal T.B. in Harper Hosp. - given up - only a few hours more - Perpetual enrollment started To-day.
7th Sad! Ralph Bradke - 27 - in Eloise - fearfully insane. However, at times seems normal ... Mother and family anxious ... Enrolled him To-day and gave them exorcism prayer , etc.
Page 186 May 7th Baby - Phil. Jos. Zerilli - 21 mo. To-day - has had twenty blood transfusions - 20th To-day ...... Enrolled and mother promises to go to Holy Com. every week instead of 3 times a year.
Arthur Decker - 58 - of D. S.R. fears loss of sight. . . out of work now January.
Mary D. Trump. - 60 - rather threatening breast ....
